authority: Where the two conflict the implementation plan wins.

amendment_1.summary: Persisted dependency closure: N-CEN filing ledger (input frame ncen_filings), per-(R,K) full-universe family contexts and memberships, persisted state-proposal evidence, directional old->new exchange relations, evidence-only adjudication subjects and rating-row binding links. v1 payloads are rejected, never decoded as v2.
amendment_1.ncen: N-CEN is fund-family provenance, never credit evidence. Effective N-CEN per FE-1 (15-month window, exact-acceptance ordering, X0505 N-CEN/A complete replacement only); FE-1a universe is every Y/N/disputed voter on R public by K with no CUSIP or flag filter; FE-1b series completeness; union-find over adviser, underwriter and B.5 family-name tokens.
amendment_1.evidence_subjects: issue_scope, followup_continuity, exchange_pairing and corroboration are evidence-only subjects admitted only by a human_reviewer accepted_evidence record; they never admit an event and are exempt from event completeness.
amendment_1.exchange: A completed distressed exchange needs a persisted directional relation per old/new pair backed by an effective human exchange_pairing; the relation valid_to is exclusive; the old->new graph is acyclic without forks; many-old-to-one-new is not supported in v2.
amendment_1.ratings: Rated rows recompute bucket, public_known_at and action_input_digest from cited actions and persisted binding links; public_known_at is the maximum relied observation and binding-link knowledge time; binding links are admitted issue-scope links valid at month end and, for public_pit, known before the month boundary; the canonical RatingScope and UnclearedRatingSource declaration record and digest are persisted and bound with approved rating packages and resolver identity by rating_input_digest.

hash_procedure.canonicalization: Parse as UTF-8 JSON rejecting duplicate object keys; remove the top-level digest key; serialize with object keys sorted recursively, separators ',' and ':', ensure_ascii false, NaN/Infinity rejected, array order preserved; encode UTF-8; hash the bytes.
hash_procedure.numbers: Only integers appear in this document; decimal quantities are strings.
hash_procedure.line_endings: Irrelevant: the digest is over the canonical serialization, not the file bytes.

month_convention.month_key: First-of-month date key m denotes the month-end snapshot of month m.
month_convention.risk_interval: (end(m), end(m+1)] in calendar days, i.e. every day of month m+1.
month_convention.outcome_window: For target month T: outcomes [T-59 months, T]; snapshot/rating keys [T-60 months, T] (61 keys, 60 outcomes).
month_convention.interval_notation: Onset bounds are (onset_lower_exclusive, onset_upper_inclusive] in calendar days.

event_types.payment_default: Missed interest or principal only after the applicable grace period expired uncured; due date, grace end and cure evidence required. Inside-grace nonpayment stays candidate.
event_types.bankruptcy: Bankruptcy or receivership with verified debtor and affected debt. Plan confirmations, solvent affiliates and uncertain petitions are corroboration or candidates, never extra events.
event_types.distressed_exchange: Completed impairment exchange to avoid default; announcement, ordinary tender or refinancing excluded. Old and new security links mandatory; the new alias never re-enters as an independent survivor.
event_types.agency_issue_default: Issue-level agency D or explicit ROCR action classification WD for the rated obligation, only from a rights-approved agency package. Action date is the recognition date, not automatically the economic date.
event_types.default_state: Accepted N-PORT C.9.c consensus state: defaulted by report date only; never an automatic incident month.

never_default_labels: technical or covenant acceleration without payment default facts
prices, spreads, market-implied ratings, FRED series
Moody's C/Ca without independent default evidence
rating-symbol WD/WR/NR or ROCR WO withdrawal
scheduled maturity, maturity floor, missing holdings or missing flags
a single N-PORT Y without independent corroboration and review
issuer SD/RD/D without affected-obligation proof for the specific CUSIP9
CIK, LEI, CUSIP6 or name matches without obligation-level link proof

evidence_statuses.accepted_evidence: human_reviewer acceptance of an evidence-only subject (issue_scope, followup_continuity, exchange_pairing, corroboration); never event-admitting

adjudication.effective_rule: Within the adjudication inventory of a publication, the effective adjudication of a subject is the unique record not superseded by another record of the same subject. A chain fork (two unsuperseded records) is a malformed inventory.

admitting_statuses.accepted_state: default_state admission; event row admission_status accepted_state
admitting_statuses.accepted_event: dated or interval event admission; event row admission_status accepted_event

human_review_required_for: conflicting sources including any material same-date N-PORT Y/N disagreement
grace period, cure and exchange completion
adjudication.policy_digest_binding: Every admitting adjudication records the digest of this policy; a publication only admits adjudications bound to its own policy digest.

classes.incident: onset_lower_exclusive is not null and every day of (lower, upper] lies in one calendar month (the month of lower+1 day equals the month of upper).
classes.interval_uncertain: onset_lower_exclusive is not null and (lower, upper] spans more than one calendar month. Never split uniformly, never assigned to first Y, never repeated defaults.
classes.prevalent: onset_lower_exclusive is null: left-censored defaulted state with unknown onset. Never invented; excluded from scalar incident counts.

timing.exact_date: An exact economic date d is stored as onset_date=d, onset_lower_exclusive=d-1 day, onset_upper_inclusive=d.
timing.recognition_date: Agency-recognition date is stored separately and never moves the economic onset.
timing.window: The bundle retains every admitted episode whose evidence is known by K, whatever its onset relative to T; consumers bound economic outcomes by T. Completeness: every effective admitting adjudication (accepted_state/accepted_event) in the publication's adjudication inventory has exactly one event row with episode_id equal to its subject_id, and every event cites the effective adjudication of its episode.

temporal_admission.evidence_known_at: max(public_available_at of every relied-on observation revision, link_known_at)
temporal_admission.link_known_at: max(link_known_at of every admitted link relied on by the event)
temporal_admission.cutoff: Admission requires evidence_known_at <= K. T limits economic outcomes; K limits knowledge, not economic dates.
temporal_admission.current_run: Additionally every relied-on observation first_seen_at, source package retrieved_at and admitting adjudication adjudicated_at are <= K.
temporal_admission.historical_reconstruction: Uses proven contemporaneous public availability and link availability only; present-day ingestion and adjudication are recorded separately and never claimed as historic possession.
temporal_admission.date_only_public_evidence: public_available_at = start of the next calendar day in the evidenced timezone, converted to UTC; never noon or midnight of the same day.
temporal_admission.edgar_acceptance: EDGAR ACCEPTANCE-DATETIME (YYYYMMDDHHMMSS) is America/New_York wall time with DST, converted to UTC; raw text retained.
temporal_admission.unknown_public_timing: Use first verified public availability conservatively; never subtract statutory lags, never use action/report/filing date as publication time.
temporal_admission.regenerated_bytes: DERA packages regenerated after the fact are not proof of earlier availability of that data version.

IS_DEFAULT.meaning: Currently in default? Holding/issue-level nullable Y/N state; not issuer-wide, not C.9.f, not an occurrence date.

ARE_ANY_INTEREST_PAYMENT.meaning: Interest payments in arrears OR coupon legally deferred; Y is arrears_or_legal_deferral_unknown, never a default label.

IS_ANY_PORTION_INTEREST_PAID.meaning: Paid in kind; never a default label.

field_presence_states.present: column exists and raw value is Y or N
field_presence_states.null: column exists and value is empty/null
field_presence_states.absent: column does not exist in the package vintage
field_presence_states.invalid: column exists and raw value is neither Y nor N (raw retained)

nport.eligibility: Launch event eligibility requires ISSUER_TYPE=CORP and ASSET_CAT=DBT; exclusion counts retained.
nport.vote_unit: (accession, series, cusip9, report_date); duplicated lots are one vote; contradictory lots within one vote dispute that vote; package copies of one accession row are one semantic observation.
nport.consensus_rule: State consensus by (cusip9, report_date): at least two distinct series AND two independently evidenced registrant/fund families report Y, with no unresolved N vote. Distinct CIK alone does not prove independent family; unknown family identity cannot supply independent second support. Same-family multiple series require independent EDGAR or authorized-agency corroboration. Any material Y/N conflict goes to human adjudication; no majority vote. Identical independence/conflict tests apply to credible N bounds. One Y remains candidate unless independently corroborated and reviewed.
nport.state_bounds: Accepted consensus Y gives accepted_state. Last credible N at a < first credible Y at b gives onset (a, b]; first Y with no prior credible N has null lower bound and is prevalent/left-censored. N before or after Y cannot by itself prove cure or a new episode. Subsequent Y observations corroborate the same episode.
nport.amendments: Filing family (registrant, series, report_date); latest accepted complete replacement available at K; never blend original and amendment rows; ambiguous partial amendment stays disputed; later-than-K amendments never replace facts in a frozen build.
nport.public_cadence: Only the third fiscal-quarter month is public under the current regime; missing report months remain missing, never survival.

episodes.unit: Issue-episode: one continuous unresolved impairment of one security (estimator unit, keyed (security_id, episode_id)); issuer_episode_id groups affected obligations of one obligor.
episodes.dedup: One issue counts once per episode regardless of documents, agencies, fund series or repeated Y months; payment failure, bankruptcy and later D/WD in the same unresolved episode are corroboration.
episodes.new_episode: Requires evidenced cure/resolution (resolution_date) of the prior episode and new impairment strictly after it; no fixed-day heuristic; disappearance/reappearance or exchange alias never resets.
episodes.disjointness: Per security, episodes are ordered by onset; every earlier episode has a resolution_date and the next episode has a non-null onset_lower_exclusive >= that resolution_date.

links.rule: Link proof includes obligor, guarantee/indenture, maturity/coupon/currency and affected scope. Suspected, ambiguous or reused identifiers are quarantined, never admitted. No CUSIP6/parent/issuer-wide propagation. Link knowledge time is independent of event time.

followup.rule: N-PORT point N observations alone never form a nondefault_continuous segment; a continuous segment needs documentary evidence beyond N-PORT or a qualified surveillance receipt. unknown has basis none.

exit_evidence.rule: Scheduled maturity is not repayment; proven repayment needs evidence. Reasons alone never generate a default or a survival.

coverage.rule: No NULL dimension key; explicit all/unknown labels. A qualified cell requires a validation receipt digest and a denominator basis other than none. Missing coverage never fabricates a pass; an empty cell is not_evaluable, never 100%.

agency_rocr_xbrl.note: Optional stream, disabled unless the manifest carries rights_state=approved with an agency/source/use authorization reference and official file provenance. Login, click-through, mirrors and the legacy license flag are not rights approval. Unapproved agency packages cannot enter a publication; missing rights leave the rating grid unqualified, never NR success.

excluded_sources: local agency mirror CSVs without approved rights

rules: Every (cusip, month) of the pinned panel grid including the start month and excluded issues has exactly one row per view.
bucket is non-null only for observed and carried_verified rows, which require action date, public known time and rights-approved agency source observations.
public_pit requires action effective by month-end and proven public knowledge before the next month boundary (UTC); current K cannot backdate availability.
effective_audit is retrospective (known by K) and forbidden as allocation or start-rating input.
Default overlay references the event episode and never claims an agency D.
Moody's C/Ca map to CCC absent independent default evidence; same-day conflicting actions need sequence evidence or dispute.
No 2025-03 cutoff in this path; no fabricated extension; legacy eligible-only buckets are comparison only.

Publication id is the RFC 9562 UUIDv8 built from the first 128 bits of the SHA-256 input fingerprint (version 8, variant 10xx); prepared_at is excluded. Exact replay verifies persisted rows then no-ops; same id with different bytes fails.

Row hashes, the validation-receipt digest and the fingerprint use the length-prefixed, type-tagged row encoding bond_credit_row_v1; bond_credit_validate recomputes every row hash, frame digest, the receipt digest, the fingerprint and the publication id from stored columns and fails on any mismatch.
Child rows are inserted only while the parent is prepared; inputs and validated builds are never updated or deleted.
A validated partial or unavailable build is a structurally valid shadow artifact, never a promotion candidate.
Promotion requires a validated, unrevoked, complete, qualified build, compare-and-set on the expected pointer (including absent), and non-regressing T and K.
qualified requires a positive validation receipt (verdict qualified); zero rows never imply qualification.
Revocation is append-only and makes readers refuse the publication immediately.
